description: Free private repo: no native GitHub auto-merge, and Actions minutes are capped, so Renovate merges itself and runs weekly (security fixes still go out immediately). Each run opens at most two PRs (plus any pre-1.0 minor, and a monthly lock-file refresh) - one automerged non-major group and one major group for review - so every update costs one CI run. Branches are rebased only on conflict, not every time master moves, so each update runs CI once.

packageRules.description: Keep npm dependencies as exact versions, matching the pinned style used everywhere else (action SHAs, container digest, requirements-ci.txt).
One PR for every non-major update across all managers (actions, mise tools, OpenTofu providers, Python, npm), automerged once CI passes.
One PR for every major update across all managers; never automerged, the maintainer reviews it.
Pre-1.0 minor bumps can break, so keep them out of the automerged group.
uv stays on 0.x but CI exercises it on every run, so its minor bumps rejoin the automerged non-major group (the maintainer's call).
mise uses calendar versions, so a new year looks like a major bump; CI exercises it on every run, so it stays in the automerged non-major group.
The 1Password CLI in app/mise.toml installs through aqua's http backend, which has no version list: read versions from 1Password's feed instead.
OpenTofu providers resolve against the OpenTofu registry (registry.opentofu.org), the same one `tofu init` uses, not registry.terraform.io.

pip_requirements.description: The requirements-*.txt files are compiled with hashes, so the pip-compile manager owns them; there are no other requirements files.

pip-compile.description: Recompile requirements-ci.txt and requirements-uv.txt (hashes and transitive pins) from their .in files on every update.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Refresh transitive pins (app/package-lock.json, requirements-*.txt) once a month, automerged once CI passes.
schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

customManagers.description: The mise version that jdx/mise-action installs (workflow input), kept in step with the mise release; tools in app/mise.toml and checksums in app/mise.lock are handled by Renovate's mise manager.
commitizen, run through uvx in the release workflow (no manifest that a built-in manager reads).

op-cli.description: 1Password CLI releases (no GitHub releases to read): 1Password's own update feed returns the latest stable version.
